summary.snippet: Derm Foundation is a machine learning model that generates embeddings for dermatology images, enabling efficient AI model development for dermatology image analysis.
Using Derm Foundation, businesses and institutions can leverage their dermatology data more effectively, needing less data and compute to build AI models.

intended_use_and_workflow.snippet:
Derm Foundation can be used for data-efficient classification tasks, including:

Furthermore, the embedding from each skin image only needs to be generated once and can be used as an input for a variety of different classifiers, with very little additional compute.
